name: willshaper
description: Surgebinders who wield Transportation and Cohesion. Willshapers are adventurers and builders, guided by a deep respect for freedom and individuality. They reshape both stone and society to uplift the oppressed.
sprenDescription: A bright, free-flowing orb of pure light that darts and dances unpredictably. Lightspren are adventurous, freedom-loving, and fiercely independent.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Willshaper swears to protect freedom, their own and others’. They will not be caged, nor allow others to be.
quotes: I will seek freedom for those who have none.
I will not be bound by chains, nor stand by while others are.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: They commit to building a world where people can choose their own paths, even when it’s difficult to allow it.
quotes: I will fight not just for survival, but for choice.
They deserve to decide who they are, even if I disagree.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: The Willshaper accepts the burden of being a disruptor, shattering walls, forging bridges, and reshaping broken systems.
quotes: I will shape the world until it no longer cages the broken.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: They become an embodiment of freedom and will, the storm that tears down tyranny and the architect of a better world.
quotes: I am will, unshackled. I shape not what is, but what must be.
